messages:
lina: Flagging a weird reconciliation delta after today's NetSuite batch push. The webhook batcher grouped several Stripe events into a single batch and the batch window was used to set invoice period. Some events had billable_ts from previous day and got assigned to the wrong invoice.

greg: Can you paste a minimal repro / logs? Is this the batcher or the netSuite mapper?

lina: Log excerpt:```2026-04-05T02:01:12Z INFO webhook-batcher: batch_id=bat_20260405_02 size=8 batch_received_at=2026-04-05T02:01:10Z events=[evt_a1,evt_b2,evt_c3,...] 2026-04-05T02:01:12Z DEBUG event: id=evt_c3 source=stripe customer=cus_44 billable_ts=2026-04-04T23:58:40Z created_ts=2026-04-04T23:58:38Z delivered_ts=2026-04-05T02:00:09Z```

lina: Batcher picks batch_received_at (2026-04-05T02:01:10Z) and maps the whole batch to that invoice period. So evt_c3 with billable_ts before midnight got bumped forward.

maria_fin: How many customers impacted and any invoices already posted to customers? We need exposure numbers before outreach.

lina: Initial scan: 3 customers had invoices posted, 5 had credits auto-created by the NetSuite sync. Total 8 affected. I exported details to the private sheet: https://redwood.internal/fin/webhook-batch-window-issue (internal only).

greg: Sounds like a logic bug: the batcher should never override per-event billable_ts when computing period. We had a similar engineering note in the payments design doc recommending per-event attribution. Maybe the fast-path optimization unintentionally regressed.

devon: I can whip a quick patch: compute invoice_window = floor_to_window(min(event.billable_ts, event.created_ts)) across events in batch, then group items into the corresponding period. Also add a per-event envelope idempotency key so retries can't create duplicates when events move between batches.

maria_fin: Are any pricing experiments involved? We recently toggled the 'tiered-usage-smoothing' feature for the Canary customers; could that change mapping?

greg: That feature affects rounding/aggregation, not window attribution. But good to verify. lina, can you grep the events for feature flags?

lina: Grep shows 2 of the affected customers were in the experiment cohort, but their misassignment is independent of rounding.

ops-bot: nightly-batch-run summary 2026-04-05T04:05:00Z - batches=412 processed_events=2,987 failed=4 dlq=4 late_delivery=12

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fin-inc/pull/510 "webhook-batcher: attribute by per-event billable_ts + idempotency envelope". Includes unit tests simulating retry bursts and out-of-order delivered events. @greg PTAL.

greg: Reviewing now. One comment: prefer using upsert with return audit fields in the mapper DB instead of delete/insert so NS audit metadata stays intact. Also add a metric `webhook.batch_event_misaligned` when event.billable_ts < batch_received_at by > 1m.

ci-bot: Pipeline for PR 510 passed all checks at 2026-04-05T07:40:21Z. integration-tests=ok e2e-billing=ok smoke=ok

devon: Deployed to staging 2026-04-05T08:10Z. Staging backfill dry-run command: `./scripts/batch_window_backfill --since 2026-04-04 --until 2026-04-05 --dry-run --only-affected`

maria_fin: Please run dry-run and post diff. If dry-run matches expectations, we want a controlled live backfill and hold on customer comms until manual review for posted invoices.

lina: Dry-run completed 2026-04-05T23:12Z. Diff shows 8 adjustments in staging output; no duplicate credits created. Pushed CSV to the PR.

devon: Live backfill scheduled 2026-04-06T01:30Z. Command run: `./scripts/batch_window_backfill --since 2026-04-04 --until 2026-04-05 --live --only-affected`

ops-bot: backfill-job summary 2026-04-06T01:45:03Z - reconciled=8 duplicates=0 manual_review=3


maria_fin: Manual review found 3 invoices requiring short manual adjustments (small $ amounts). Finance will post memo with customer impact and run approvals. Please don't auto-notify customers until I confirm phrasing.

greg: I'll merge the PR and add the metric + alert. Recommend `webhook.batch_event_misaligned > 2 for 10m` to trigger paging.

devon: Added metric and Datadog alert. Also added a tiny synthetic test that replays Stripe retry bursts as part of integration.

lina: Follow-ups: (1) patch mapper DB upsert per greg, (2) add longer retention for webhook DLQ messages for 48h so backfills can re-run, (3) ops to keep manual rollback playbook ready.

maria_fin: Thanks all. Once I approve customer text I'll send to comms and ops. For now finance will absorb small adjustments under rounding tolerance.

greg: Closing loop: PR merged, staging prod rollout scheduled tomorrow 02:00 UTC with feature flag gate.

ci-bot: Deployed pr-510 to prod-canary at 2026-04-06T02:10:12Z. smoke tests passed.

lina: Thanks everyone. Putting ticket in backlog for bigger rework of aggregator to avoid batch-window heuristics: FIN-789. Will follow up with postmortem if any additional cases pop up. :white_check_mark:
